**Director of Technology (IT)**

SPC Mechanical | Reports to the President | Full-time, on site with regular travel to our offices and jobsites

**About SPC**

SPC Mechanical is a 100% employee-owned mechanical and plumbing contractor serving the Southeast with focus in NC, SC, and VA markets since 1965. We're a full turnkey provider for both mechanical and plumbing packages. Our purpose is Building Better Together: we partner early with customers and plan, deliver and service projects as one integrated team, from estimating and preconstruction through virtual design, prefabrication, field execution, startup and service.

Technology is built into how we work, from our Lean production system (O.P.S.) to building every job virtually before we build it in the field. We're growing, and we need a technology leader who will get out in front of that growth and help lead the business.

**The seat**

The Director of Technology leads SPC's technology strategy and the IT team, reports to the President, and is part of the conversations that shape where the company is going. This is not a help desk or server maintenance job. We need a leader who will **lead it and own it**:

* **See:** spend real time in the field, the shop and every department. Understand how we build, estimate and manage work, and spot where technology can give us an edge before anyone asks.
* **Do:** turn what you see into a plan, make the calls, bring the business along, and deliver results we can measure in hours, dollars and risk.

**The 5 roles of this seat**

* **Technology vision and plan.** Own SPC's technology plan and IT budget, tied to our company goals. Bring ideas to the leadership team instead of waiting for requests, and report progress to the President each quarter.

**About Unist**

Unist is a world leader in the design and manufacture of fluid application systems for industrial markets. Our systems help manufacturers improve process efficiency while reducing lubricant use, waste, and environmental impact.

For nearly 70 years, we have built our reputation by developing innovative products, solving challenging applications, and taking care of our customers. We are a family-owned company with customers around the world and a team that takes pride in making products that provide long-term value.

**About the Opportunity**

Engineering at Unist covers a lot of ground. Our team develops new products, creates customized solutions for customers, supports manufacturing, improves existing products, and solves the technical challenges that come with being a high-mix, low-volume manufacturer.

We are looking for an Engineering Director to lead a team of approximately nine across design engineering, manufacturing/support engineering, and CAD. Reporting directly to the President, this role will have significant influence on how we develop our engineering team and support Unist's continued growth. A major focus will be bringing these groups together as one coordinated engineering organization with clear priorities, responsibilities, and accountability.

This is a hands-on leadership position. We need someone with the technical background to understand the work and earn credibility with the team, but success isn't about being the person who solves every engineering problem. It's about developing people, making sound decisions, providing clear direction, and giving others the ownership to do their jobs.

Early success will mean understanding our people, products, and manufacturing operation, then establishing clear ownership, visible priorities, and dependable follow-through across engineering.

This is a full-time, onsite position at our Grand Rapids, Michigan facility.

**What You'll Do**

· Lead our design engineering, manufacturing/support engineering, and CAD teams as one coordinated department with clear roles, responsibilities, priorities, and working relationships.

· Set direction and balance the needs of product development, customer applications, manufacturing support, and continuous improvement as priorities shift.

· Make timely engineering decisions using sound technical judgment, while recognizing when additional review or escalation is needed.

· Establish practical engineering processes, standards, and procedures, including design reviews, documentation, and release practices, that improve quality, consistency, delivery, and accountability.

Veracross provides SaaS-based School Information Systems (SIS) designed to meet the specific needs of independent K-12 schools worldwide. Our one-record solution combines the power of a fully integrated single-record database, personalized communication tools, and an elegant architecture that is unique in our industry.

We are a growing, values-led community of employees in the US, UK and Australia who share a vision to unify school communities, improve the quality of education, and enhance learning.

Veracross is five product brands in one global tech company

* **Veracross SIS** is a one-person, one-record school management platform

* Maintain an enterprise view of AI initiatives, owners, adoption, and realized value, and use it to reduce duplication and focus investment where the value is greatest.

Zep Inc. is a leading manufacturer of cleaning solutions for businesses and consumers with operations across the U.S, Canada, and Europe. AI computing company: we turn GPU hardware into reliable, high-utilization AI compute through software, orchestration and full lifecycle operations.

* A track record of leading incident response, root-cause analysis and reliability improvement programs
* Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001 or similar audits

Company Overview

We are the better way to work in finance. As private equity’s value creation partner, we sit at the heart of PE—where sponsors and CFOs meet. Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive value—supporting the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.

If you crave challenging work and are looking to grow, come solve complex problems alongside a team of finance and technology professionals in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Backed by leading private equity investors, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm with a global presence. We are looking for people who want to help build something great and make a lasting impact.

Data & Analytics

Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) team offers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.

We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.

We deliver data and analytical solutions designed to streamline reporting capabilities and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.

This role can be based in any of our US office locations and is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work remotely 2 days a week. Ideal candidates should be local to the desired location.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

We're looking for a rare combination: a data scientist who thinks like a strategist and a strategist who speaks fluent data. You fall in love with problems and quantify complex situations using math. This isn't a role about building models in isolation—it's about transforming how a business makes decisions, identifies opportunities, and drives growth. You'll be equal parts analyst, advisor, and architect of our strategic direction.

What You'll Do

You'll sit at the intersection of data and strategy, turning complex business challenges into quantifiable opportunities. This means diving deep into our numbers to surface insights that others miss, then translating those insights into actionable growth strategies. You'll work directly with leadership to shape major business decisions, from market expansion and pricing strategy to resource allocation and competitive positioning.

Your day-to-day will involve identifying the right questions to ask before anyone else thinks to ask them, building the analytical frameworks to answer those questions, and presenting recommendations that fundamentally shift how we operate. AffirmedRx is a transparent, pass-through pharmacy benefit manager and a Public Benefit Corporation. - Recommend against AI when another solution is better, and keep a portfolio that records what was approved, declined, and retired

Workflow Redesign and Delivery:
- Redesign how work gets done, not just add tools to existing steps
- Build reusable templates, prompt libraries, and automations on AffirmedRx's approved AI platforms
- Pilot each use case with defined measures, then scale it, adjust it, or stop it

Quality, Accuracy, and Data Protection:
- Set review standards for AI-assisted work, with the strongest controls on externally facing content such as RFP responses, sales and marketing materials, client communications, and legal and finance documents
- Ensure source verification and human review before AI-assisted work leaves the company
- Keep PHI and confidential information out of general-purpose workflows, consistent with AffirmedRx policy

Governance Partnership:
- Bring every AI use case through AffirmedRx's governance routing (IT Steering Committee and AI Governance Committee) for risk review and approval. This role advances use cases and does not approve its own work
- Document each use case for the AI inventory, and report incidents, exceptions, and lessons learned
- Review vendor AI features that affect business functions and raise concerns early

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers' ongoing Mission Readiness. From the moment they say "go" until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.

Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not "core" to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.

Within Mission Readiness, our Maintenance Repair & Overhaul (MRO) function provides capability to repair durable products to extend their useful life.
Repair Engineering is the core technical function for Anduril’s component and hardware in-house maintenance capabilities.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Director of Repair Engineering to build, from the ground up, the technical engineering backbone of Anduril’s repair function. This discipline is nascent at Anduril today. Production engineers handle returns, but the dedicated practice of assessing acceptable wear, developing non-production repair methods, and determining when a product is ‘serviceable but not like new’ does not yet exist as a standalone function. You will create it. Where our Head of MRO is building and running the repair organization itself, this role owns the engineering rigor underneath it: the repair-versus-discard decisions, the maintenance task analyses, the repair procedures and the product support data that determine what gets fixed, how, and at what level. We are seeking a Director of Engineering to serve as the systems architect and technical authority across our Containerized Effects (CE), and Advanced Expeditionary Systems (AES) product lines. As Chief Engineer, you will lead the end-to-end architecture and technical delivery across modular containerized systems—including missile launchers, high-power microwave/directed energy vectors, and sensor payloads. greenhouse:anello photonics:4730399006.description:
About ANELLO:

Founded by pioneers in silicon photonics and navigation sensor technology, ANELLO has developed integrated photonic system-on-chip technology for next generation navigation. ANELLO's SIPHOG™ optical gyroscope is based on its patented photonic integrated circuit technology. Our products are high performance, low-power, much smaller size and weight, at a fraction of the cost of traditional optical gyros used in industrial, aerospace and military applications. They enable reliable and accurate navigation and positioning across autonomous applications and within GPS-denied environments. ANELLO has a growing list of customers in commercial and defense segments and scaling production significantly due in part to contracts in the UAV/USV Defense segments.

The Role:

We are moving our gyroscope and IMU electronics from discrete boards to a single, highly integrated mixed signal ASIC. This chip is the step that takes optical-gyroscope precision into high-volume products. As Director, ASIC Engineering, you will own this chip from definition to production. You will lead the program through a top-tier ASIC design partner to first silicon in less than two years. Then you will build ANELLO's in house ASIC organization and define the chips that follow.

Why This Role:
- Full ownership. One chip, one leader. You make the key decisions, from partner selection to tapeout.
- A hard, interesting chip. Low-noise optical receivers, data converters, precision references, power stages, and an embedded processor that runs the IMU sensor hub, all on one die.
- Build from the ground up. Hire the first engineers, set the flows, and shape the in-house team for future generations.
- Real-world impact. Your silicon goes into navigation systems that people depend on when GPS fails.
- Executive visibility. The ASIC is central to the company roadmap, and you work directly with the leadership team.

What You Will Do:
- Own the ASIC program end to end: scope, schedule, budget, risk, and the tapeout decision.
- Lead vendor selection through RFI, RFP, and RFQ. Select the design partner, the process, and the foundry.
- Lead the design partner at the technical level. Drive the design reviews, and hold a high bar on verification and sign-off.
- Own the specification. Make sure that the ASIC is a drop-in replacement for today's discrete electronics.
- Integrate the work outside the partner's scope: signal-processing RTL, firmware, package, photonics, and test.
- Lead silicon bring-up, characterization, qualification, and the ramp to production.
- Hire a small, strong core team now, and grow it into ANELLO's in-house ASIC organization.

What You Bring:
- BS in Electrical Engineering or a related field. MS or PhD preferred.
- 15+ years in ASIC development, including 5+ years leading ASIC teams or programs.
- Hands-on roots in analog/mixed-signal design or verification. You have designed silicon yourself.
- A record of shipping mixed-signal ASICs from specification to volume

You will own the security posture, build a technical roadmap alongside the product roadmap, and grow a team that spans seasoned telecom engineers and early-career developers.

About the role

Availability and resilience are core to keeping Chime reliable for millions of members who count on us for their everyday financial lives. The Incident & Availability Engineering organization is responsible for the systems, tooling, and culture that keep Chime up, resilient to outages, and fast to recover when incidents occur. We're looking for a Director to lead this org and define what comes next: an intelligent, automated platform where AI and ML aid in real-time incident triage, root cause analysis, and automated mitigation. If you have experience building scalable availability, reliability, and incident response systems and want to lead this critical pillar of Chime's technical infrastructure, we'd love to talk.

- Set the multi-year vision and roadmap. Unify incident management, alerting, chaos engineering, and availability tracking into an intuitive, seamless reliability platform.

- 10+ years in software or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years leading teams and at least 2 years leading tech lead managers or engineering managers in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure, or Availability domains.

Director of IT Support

Lead the team that keeps our people connected, productive, and moving forward.

Cottingham & Butler is seeking an experienced Director of IT Support to lead our IT Service Desk and deliver an exceptional technology experience across the organization.

This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who combines strong IT service-delivery experience with a genuine commitment to helping people. You’ll lead and develop a talented support team, strengthen processes, and partner with leaders across the business to ensure employees have the technology, tools, and support they need to do their best work.

What You’ll Do

-
Lead, coach, and develop the IT Support team, while staying actively involved in day-to-day Service Desk operations, including ticket triage and assisting the team with active support tickets.
- Oversee day-to-day IT service delivery for employees, including desktop hardware, software, and conference room technology.
- Build a responsive, service-oriented support environment focused on quality, consistency, and a positive employee experience.
- Partner with department leaders to understand their technology support needs and identify effective solutions.
- Collaborate with the Vice President of Information Technologies on service priorities, business needs, and special projects.
- Maintain accurate inventories of hardware and software installed on employee equipment.
- Oversee the technology-related planning and execution required when employees or teams move to different locations.
- Ensure Service Desk procedures and knowledge-base articles remain accurate, practical, and up to date.
- Identify opportunities to improve workflows, strengthen support processes, and increase the overall effectiveness of the IT Support function.

What We’re Looking For
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field.
- At least 10 years of experience in IT service delivery, technical support, or a related area.
- Demonstrated experience leading, developing, and motivating an IT support team.
- Strong understanding of desktop hardware, software, IT asset management, and end-user support.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- A service-oriented mindset and the ability to build strong relationships with employees and leaders throughout the organization.
- A positive, solutions-focused approach, especially when navigating competing priorities or technical challenges.

About Cottingham & Butler:

At Cottingham & Butler, we sell a promise to help our clients through life’s toughest moments. To deliver on that promise, we aim to hire, train, and grow the best professionals in the industry. We look for people with an insatiable desire to succeed, are committed to growing, and thrive on challenges. Our culture is guided by the theme of “better every day” constantly pushing ourselves to be better than yesterday – that’s who we are and what we believe in.

About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

We are looking for an engineering leader to own how our organization delivers the best-in-class Crunchyroll application and user experience across living room devices. You will lead the engineers who build and evolve our core application framework and the consumer-facing surfaces built on it. As a leader of this team, you will be accountable for the pace, reliability, and quality of what that team ships.

This is a technical role focused on delivery, guiding the team on architecture, operational excellence, and people management. You set technical direction in close partnership with our principal front-end engineer, and you are accountable for making sure the team builds to that direction and ships to it. You work cross-functionally with product, design, analytics, and engineering partners who are closest to the Living Room Experience (LRX).

As an Engineering Director, you will report to the Senior Director of Engineering in the Fan Experiences Engineering group. This is a hybrid position based out of our San Francisco office.

What You'll Do:

Team Leadership & Delivery
- Lead, grow, and develop the LRX Core and UI teams spanning multiple locations, holding responsibility for their delivery, quality, and reliability.
- Own execution of the team’s roadmap: turn business and product goals into a sequenced, credible plan and deliver against it, adjusting as outcomes dictate.
- Set clear quality benchmarks and hold the line on them while keeping momentum.
- Be a hands-on leader: close enough to the work to make sound calls, unblock the team quickly, understand the code to review and validate the technical decisions by the team, and stay credible with senior engineers.

Technical Direction
- Set technical direction for the team in partnership with the principal/staff engineers, and make the team accountable to the agreed architecture, standards, and performance budgets.
- Balance the long-term architecture and scalability of the systems against short-term deliverables that contribute to business outcomes, and make the trade-off calls transparently.
- Guide the team through the ongoing evolution of the LRX application stack without losing delivery pace.

Cross-Functional Partnership
- Build strong, trusted working relationships with product, design, analytics, and other engineering teams.
- Align and set clear, realistic expectations and status on delivery.

RDQ428R2

At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world’s toughest problems by partnering with the ISVs that drive innovation across every line of business. We enable our partners to bring deep intelligence into the critical workflows their customers rely on every day, from delivering real-time CRM behavioral insights to optimizing complex supply chains impacted by global events. We do this by building and running the world’s best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high-value challenges that are central to their own missions.

Founded in 2013 by the original creators of Apache Spark, Databricks has grown from a tiny corner office in Berkeley, CA to a global organization with over 8,000 employees. Thousands of organizations, from small startups to Fortune 100, trust Databricks with their mission-critical workloads, making us one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the world and one of the top 5 move valuable private companies.

About the role:

As the Sr. Technology Partner Director, Platform Partnerships, you will be responsible for developing, managing, and scaling our global partner ecosystem that makes Databricks the best place to run data-and-AI-intensive workloads central to core enterprise data management lifecycle. You will build and own strategic partnerships with a set of top ISVs across data lifecycle categories, BI, Data Governance, Observability — driving Marketplace strategy and execution, building joint solutions, co-creating joint GTM plays, and helping our field and customers realize the value of combining Databricks with leading data lifecycle partners.

We are looking for someone who has previously managed data ecosystem ISVs at a hyperscaler or worked at a leading Technology ISV. The role demands both technical and GTM acumen — able to work with Product and Engineering teams on integrations, as well as with Sales and Marketing teams on go-to-market execution. It is a fast-paced, cross-functional role requiring strong communication, prioritization, and presentation skills, and the ability to quickly context-switch between product, engineering, and field conversations. Success will require deep subject matter expertise in large-scale technology ecosystems, coupled with a scrappy, entrepreneurial spirit to build partnerships that establish Databricks as the best place to partner and run analytics  workloads for years to come.  This may include leveraging AI to build automation into yours and the team’s workflow as Databricks looks to scale with optimized resources.

The impact you’ll have:
- Build and own comprehensive, end-to-end partnership business plans for a portfolio of top-tier ISVs, integrating GTM strategies including driving Marketplace revenue, product innovation roadmaps, and marketing initiatives to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Datadog is the unified observability, security, and AI platform for cloud applications. Our SaaS solution integrates infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring, and log management to deliver real-time, end-to-end visibility into the entire technology stack.

Trusted by over 30,500+ organizations worldwide, from startups to global enterprises, Datadog helps drive digital transformation, accelerate cloud migration, and foster collaboration across development, operations, security, and business teams. Our platform enables faster time to market, shorter incident resolution cycles, deeper visibility into user behavior, improved application and infrastructure security, and insights into critical business metrics.

Customers include leading brands such as Peloton, Sweetgreen, Condé Nast, DoorDash, Nasdaq, Whole Foods, Samsung, Sonos, AARP, and Eventbrite. As businesses continue to prioritize digital agility and resilient cloud operations, Datadog remains at the forefront of innovation and growth.

- Named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Observability Platforms, marking five straight years of recognition based on both vision and execution.

- Unveiled major innovations at DASH 2025, including AI security tools, LLM-powered observability features (like AI Agents Console, Bits AI, and internal developer portals), expanded automation and Kubernetes autoscaling, and long-term log retention and governance capabilities.
- Joined the Forbes Global 2000 List—a testament to Datadog’s growing global impact and financial strength, driven by ~26% year-over-year revenue growth to $2.8B in trailing twelve months through March 2025.
- Expanding its global footprint, with a new India hub launching in Bengaluru and enhanced data center presence in Australia to meet customer demand and regulatory requirements in APJ.
- Recognized as an AI beneficiary by Wall Street: analysts at BofA upgraded Datadog as a “top pick” based on strong AI-native revenue (8.5% of ARR), customer confidence, and projected durable growth despite ongoing macro challenges.

About the Role

Datadog’s Technical Solutions (TS) organization is a global, high-impact team of approximately ~1,200 professionals responsible for delivering deep technical engagement at every stage of the customer lifecycle. This includes a broad spectrum of functions from Sales Engineering (SE) during pre-sales discovery, to Technical Account Management (TAM) and Implementation Services (IS) during onboarding and post-sales success, to Technical Support Engineering (TSE) and Product Solutions Architecture (PSA) driving scale, retention, and product feedback loops. The Dropbox Business Development team builds strategic partnerships that expand product adoption, create new distribution channels, and drive long-term customer and revenue growth. We are hiring a Director of Strategic AI Partnerships to own a focused portfolio of Dropbox’s highest-priority AI relationships, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta.

About FL128

FL128 is building an adaptive, personalized care system that changes how people search for, find, and interact with healthcare. We are building an agent-native, patient-facing platform that helps someone bring us a health question, get a practical action plan, follow it, generate personalized health evidence, and use that information to guide the next step.

As AI transforms how patients engage with health advice, personal data, and care systems, we have a significant opportunity to reshape healthcare around individuals and build closed-loop care that helps people stay healthier for longer. Our advantage will come from identifying the people we can uniquely serve, building a care loop they want to return to, and making disciplined choices about what to build—and what not to build.

The Role

We are hiring FL128’s first full-time employee: a founding product leader at the Director level, reporting to our co-founders. We are looking for someone who wants to make the product decisions that define a company: a product leader with unusual taste, technical range, patient empathy, and the appetite to build in one of the hardest and most consequential categories in technology. You will own the product direction for the platform and help take a differentiated early product bet, that is already in the hands of its earliest adopters, into its next phase: a focused, durable product company.

This is a technical, hands-on role on a lean, AI-native, agent-focused team. You should be comfortable using agentic coding tools to prototype and investigate ideas, participating in code review, and reading tests well enough to spot when the implementation no longer matches the precise product intent. You will also help build the operating discipline behind the product: a practical cadence for planning, prioritizing, shipping, and learning; clear standards for quality and safety; and decision-making that is fast without being casual.

What You’ll Do
- Partner directly with the founders to turn FL128’s differentiated early product bet into a focused product thesis, a clear roadmap, and a sequence of high-conviction decisions.
- Own the closed-loop care experience end to end: help patients move from uncertainty to an appropriate action, follow through, understand what happened, and know what to do next. Importantly, you are obsessed with ensuring that engaged users keep coming back.
- Build the product operating system for FL128: strategy documents, specifications, success measures, sprint planning, reviews, launch standards, and post-launch learning.
- Lead the platform onto Android, MCP, and other high-leverage consumer surfaces while preserving one coherent, deeply considered patient experience.
- Define the AI and agent layer of the product: what agents can do, what context and tools they need, where a human must intervene, and how quality, safety, and trust are proven in production.
- Work directly with engineering on architecture, scope, instrumentation

That’s what we do.

- Understand the user through research and competitive analysis. Anticipate market need and Identify gaps where Formlabs can excel.
- Be a product thought leader that anyone in the company could count on as a subject matter expert.
- Mentor and develop existing team members of product managers.
- Make hiring a priority - always be on the lookout for top talent and be able to identify a fit for the team.
- Navigate ambiguity and come away with a roadmap. Be comfortable with building something that has never been done before.

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Team

The Security Operations Team at Harness is a small, high-leverage organization responsible for how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats across our cloud environment and the platform we run for customers. We measure ourselves against NIST CSF 2.0 and work closely with Cloud Security, IAM, Product Security, and Platform Engineering. We design for assume-breach: layered preventive controls, strong identity as the perimeter, and fast detection and response.

The Role

We are looking for a Director to own Security Operations (SOC), Detection Engineering, and Incident Response at Harness. You will build and lead the team that monitors our environment, engineers high-quality detections, and responds to incidents, and you will be accountable for how quickly and reliably we find and contain threats.

This is a player-coach leadership role. You are expected to stay close to the technical work, set the detection and response strategy, and build the team, tooling, and metrics that make Security Operations scalable.

- Lead the SOC, including monitoring, triage, escalation, and on-call coverage, and manage any external SOC or managed detection and response (MDR) partners.
- Own the incident response lifecycle: runbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication for high-severity incidents, and post-incident reviews that drive lasting fixes.

We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

Job Overview

Hasbro is looking for an engineering-focused leader to oversee Finance Applications Engineering and transform our Finance and Treasury technology ecosystem. In this role, you will shape how Finance teams build and use technology while leading and developing a high-performing technical team. This leader will manage the ongoing operation and upgrade of our primary Finance platforms — including SAP’s S/4HANA, expense management tool Concur, treasury solution REVAL, financial planning system Longview, and our Licensing/royalty and rights-management systems (Alliant/Rightsline, IPM from Fadel). They will also lead a major change in how the team delivers new functions by crafting tailored microservices, interfaces, and automated solutions using advanced technology on and around these systems instead of depending only on native configuration.

The ideal candidate will have strong accountability for enterprise Finance platforms along with practical engineering leadership. They will build cloud-native, API-first, and technology-enhanced solutions to expand the functionality of our core applications. This position combines maintaining a reliable, well-controlled Finance technology infrastructure with leading the group’s evolution into a forward-looking product-engineering organization that develops smart, automated financial processes.

You will partner closely with senior Finance leaders as a strategic liaison between IT and Finance, while leading, mentoring, and developing a high-performing technical team.

Location and Work Arrangement

This role is based at our Boston, Massachusetts office and follows a hybrid schedule designed to support in-person collaboration. Employees are expected to work onsite on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or onsite on Mondays and Fridays.

- Develop and implement a Finance & Treasury applications strategy and roadmap that maintains investment in core platforms (S/4HANA, Concur, treasury risk management tools, financial planning software, and rights administration systems) alongside a growing collection of custom microservices, APIs, and advanced capabilities.
- Guide the team’s shift from a configuration-focused approach to a product-engineering model for Finance systems. New capabilities will be delivered more through code, integration, and automation instead of only using native application customization.
- Develop and manage microservices and APIs that improve the financial modules of SAP S/4HANA along with Concur, REVAL, Longv

iCapital is looking to hire a Senior Vice President Platform Engineer to join the Platform Infrastructure Team. This team plays a critical role in keeping the production and development environments running smoothly and securely. - Participate in platform application and service design reviews, threat modeling, incident response, and post-mortems.
- Support audits and compliance requirements through automated evidence collection.

Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Our engineers work with customers to design, build and ship AI agent deployments that resolve real customer service volume. At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. To do this, we start with our own community by creating an open, inclusive, and diverse organization.

Data Science is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. As the Director, Data Science for Lyft EU, you will work in a dynamic environment, where we embrace moving quickly to build the world’s best transportation. Data Scientists take on a variety of problems, ranging from shaping critical business decisions to building algorithms that power our business insights.

We’re looking for a passionate, driven Director, Data Science with strong experience in  two-sided marketplaces and production machine learning to take on some of the most interesting and impactful problems and lead some of the best scientists in the industry.

This role will be overseeing the Product Science teams, which drive experimentation, metrics, and product insights across rider and driver experiences, and the ML Engineering teams, which build and operate the production models behind pricing, matching, ETAs, and marketplace efficiency. You will be working on one of the most profitable and fastest growing revenue centers in our company. We are the team that solves some of mobility’s hardest problems: balancing supply and demand in real time, setting prices that work for riders and drivers, and measuring the true impact of product changes in a two-sided marketplace.

As a trusted leader in the broader Data Science org, you will define and drive the Data Science strategy, vision, and roadmap for Lyft EU, while ensuring that the team has all the necessary tools and infrastructure to perform their work. You will also be responsible for building and executing a strategy for self-service data science and analytics experiences across the organization, overseeing the Science, Product, and ML Engineering teams for Lyft Europe. In this role, you will be a key partner to Engineering, Operations, Regional leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure consistent delivery of what the organization and our partners need.

Responsibilities:
- Build and lead a high-performing team of data scientists
- Experience leading and managing teams of managers is preferred

- Prioritize and lead development of productized models to automate operational decision-making and drive operational productivity
- Develop analytical frameworks, roadmaps, and metrics for the team and broader organization
- Collaborate with other leaders and executives to build data-informed business strategy and product roadmaps
- Serve as a champion of sound decision-making at all levels of the company

Experience:

- 4+ years demonstrated

greenhouse:lyft:8957597002.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Every ride on Lyft runs on infrastructure. Every match between a rider and a driver, every price, every payment, every map and every arrival estimate depends on platforms that have to be fast, reliable and efficient at a global scale. This role leads the organization that builds and runs those platforms.

Why this role matters

This is one of the most impactful engineering leadership roles at Lyft. You will be accountable for one of Lyft's largest operating investments: the cost of hosting, running and scaling the entire company on a public cloud, including our growing AI infrastructure spend. This role spans the full infrastructure stack, carries one of Lyft’s largest operating budgets, and directly determines how well Lyft’s product works and what it costs to run.

Reporting to Lyft’s Chief Technology Officer, you will lead an organization of approximately 200 engineers, engineering managers and senior technical leaders to efficiently execute on the right goals to drive impact while maintaining a sense of community.

Responsibilities:

You will lead the organization that builds and runs the platforms every Lyft engineer depends on. You’ll guide a team of engineering managers and senior technical leaders, and you’ll be accountable for the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of the systems that keep riders and drivers moving.

What you’ll own
- Core hosting infrastructure . The hosting and compute foundation Lyft runs on in the public cloud, including our Kubernetes clusters and container platform, networking, storage, and the core services every product team depends on.
- Data infrastructure. The databases, data stores and foundational data services that keep rider, driver and marketplace data available, durable and fast.

Navan is seeking a strategic, builder-minded Head of Applied AI Engineering to turn cutting-edge AI capabilities into measurable business impact across our organization. Sitting at the intersection of engineering, product, and business operations, you will own Navan’s internal applied AI strategy—identifying high-leverage operational opportunities, architecting our internal AI ecosystem, and accelerating how every department builds and deploys AI solutions.
In this role, you will treat our internal AI platforms and agentic frameworks as internal products, partner with business leaders to move high-ROI use cases from prototype to production, and lead a cross-functional network of AI Champions that embeds an AI-first operating model across the company.

What You'll Do
- Own Applied AI Strategy & Execution: Define and execute Navan’s internal applied AI roadmap—partnering with department heads to identify, prioritize, and ship high-ROI automation and agentic workflows tied to productivity, margin, and speed.

- Establish Applied Governance & Evaluation: Partner with Security, Legal, and Data teams to implement practical guardrails, data privacy standards, and evaluation frameworks so teams can innovate rapidly without compromising trust or compliance.

- Enablement & Change Leadership: Demonstrated success designing and leading practical technical enablement, building active builder communities, and translating complex AI capabilities into clear, actionable playbooks for non-technical teams.

- Builder & Prototyping Track Record: Proven ability to rapidly architect, test, and validate functional AI solutions and agents, with experience transitioning successful pilots into durable operational workflows.

Role: Director, People Operations

Location: South San Francisco, CA

Reports To: Head of People

About the Role

Ohalo is seeking an execution-driven, highly operational, and AI-forward Director of People Operations to build and run the operational engine of our People function. Reporting to the Head of People, you will own the People Operations infrastructure end-to-end to ensure we can continue to rapidly scale without friction.

This is a builder’s and doer’s seat, not an overseer’s role. You will own nearly all People Operations work end-to-end and should be energized by getting into the details when it matters, while simultaneously building the automated systems and AI agents that create massive leverage for the team. Your job is to help make Ohalo team members more effective, and you’ll work directly with the Head of People and organizational leaders to define, design, and implement People systems, processes, and programs in the most ideal way.

What You’ll Do

Learning & Development
- Own learning and development programs for managers and employees, from needs assessment through delivery and measurement.
- Collaborate with Facilities and Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) on workplace safety protocols and operational readiness across office, lab, and greenhouse facilities.

HR Operations
- Author, implement, and maintain comprehensive SOPs, runbooks, and workflows across every People Operations function (onboarding, offboarding, leave management, payroll, compliance, and contractor management).
- Own employee relations in full across all sites, including all employee relations investigations, with site-specific support from the HR Generalist.
- Own workers’ compensation end to end, including claims, policy, posters, and trainings.
- Own end-to-end administration of all employee leaves of absence, coordinating state wage-replacement benefits, return-to-work plans, and interactive accommodation processes.

Payroll Operations
- Own payroll oversight and ownership across multi-state and international footprints, with execution support from HR Generalist. Manage state registrations, payroll taxes, filings, compliance items, and multi-state rules; payroll controls; incentive compensation payout approvals and timing; off-cycle adjustments; and platform migrations.
- Own time and attendance end-to-end, from timekeeping systems and manager approvals to auditing and reporting on overtime, etc., with execution support from HR Generalist.
- Enforce strict compliance with federal, state, and local wage-and-hour laws. Develop and deliver practical wage & hour trainings for managers and employees.

Total Rewards
- Own the operational execution of Ohalo’s compensation philosophy; manage and update salary bands, job architecture, leveling frameworks, and compensation matrices.
- Conduct regular salary benchmarking and market analysis to ensure competitiveness, pay parity, and strict compliance with pay transparency legislation.

greenhouse:pacific fusion:4523229009.description:
About Pacific Fusion

Pacific Fusion was founded in 2023 with the mission to power the world with abundant, affordable, clean energy.

We are rapidly designing and building a pulser-driven inertial fusion system to achieve net facility gain (more fusion energy output than stored energy input). In parallel, we are developing the key components required to build affordable fusion systems.

Our plans are ambitious. We have raised over $900M so far from incredible investors, resourcing us to deliver on these plans. We are bringing together the best scientists, engineers, and operators from the fusion community, hard tech industry, and other sectors. We are united by a shared sense of urgency to provide clean power for the world, particularly managing climate change while meeting growing global energy demand. You can read more about us in  this letter from our founders .

Why This Role Matters

The Head of IT Security will lead our security operations to help build a world-class IT organization ready to tackle Pacific Fusion's growing technical needs. This role plays a critical part in supporting our distributed workforce across California and New Mexico with reliable and secure communication infrastructure. By establishing robust security practices across hardware R&D labs, manufacturing lines, and cloud environments, you will ensure our sensitive data, supply chain, hardware assets, and advanced fusion research intellectual property remain fully protected against sophisticated threats.

What You'll Do
- Incident response & physical hardware security. Be accountable for triage standards, severity and escalation, lead complex investigations across R&D lab environments and IT infrastructure, and own the relationship with our response partner, including when to engage them.
- Vulnerability management and detection. Run the vulnerability program from scan cadence and risk-based prioritization through remediation tracking and penetration test scoping. Build and tune in-house detection across SIEM, EDR and DLP at a scale a small team can sustain.
- Access and security design. Set access standards, run periodic access reviews, review endpoint security standards, and provide security requirements for network and cloud work without owning infrastructure operations.
- Supply chain, vendors & defense partners. Secure our hardware supply chain against tampering and espionage, review the security of new vendors, tools, hardware components, and service providers, and work with government cybersecurity programs, defense insurers, and security partners.
- Program support. Draft policy updates from operational findings for Head of IT approval, coordinate evidence for audits and insurer assessments, and prioritize competing security requests.
- Resilience, awareness and team. Run incident tabletops, contribute to continuity planning, run security awareness and phishing programs, and mentor engineers from day one, handing them ownership of technical areas as they grow.

Palmetto is a consumer energy platform that provides homeowners with a single destination to discover, purchase, finance, install, monitor and manage home energy products and services. By offering one integrated platform across solar, battery storage, HVAC, heat pumps and more, Palmetto helps homeowners make home energy more affordable, reliable and accessible. Today Palmetto serves hundreds of thousands of homeowners, across 30+ states, building the operating infrastructure for the consumer energy transition, one home at a time.

Our employees are our most valuable resource. We foster a promote-from-within culture that prioritizes talent development, career growth, and purpose-driven work. Palmetto offers a comprehensive benefits package—including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid parental leave, retirement plans, and more—so you can have it all both personally and professionally. Palmetto prioritizes people, planet, and profit—backed by a culture that values collaboration, impact, and balance. Join us in building a brighter, cleaner world.

We are seeking a visionary and pragmatic leader to serve as Palmetto’s Director of Data & AI. You will lead the teams that build Palmetto’s data foundation and the models and insights that run on it: Data Platform, Data Analytics, Data Science, and Machine Learning.

You will own the roadmap and delivery for these teams, set the quality bar, and partner with Consumer, Finance, Product, and Operations leaders on what to build first. This role is both strategic and operational: setting the vision for how we use data, and ensuring the execution of that vision through organizational leadership, scalable processes, and cutting-edge technology.

Data Platform
- Own delivery of a secure, scalable data platform: ingestion, pipelines, warehouse, data contracts, and reliability.
- Set shared standards for data quality, lineage, and cost, and decide where to build vs buy.
- Make sure the platform works well for data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists, and partner teams.

- Own the shared metric layer so Finance, Consumer, and Operations work from the same numbers.

- Prioritize data science and ML work by business impact (e.g., conversion, cancellation risk, cycle time, finance forecasting).

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the  flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

- Technical depth - Experience with LLM and agentic harness architectures.
- Tack record of successful partnerships with infrastructure, ML, and product teams.
- Experience working directly or cross functionally with monetizations teams at scale
- Experience directly managing individual contributors of varying levels
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.

About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About the Role

We are seeking a Technical Director, Government Program to serve as DEFCON AI’s technical point of contact for a new program supporting a government customer. The program will deliver predictive analytics and decision support into a secure government cloud environment, working alongside the customer’s operations staff and an industry partner.

This role will work approximately 50% onsite at a cleared customer facility in Northern Virginia , with hybrid flexibility based on program needs.

You will own the technical solution and its execution , including the architecture, delivery plan, deployment into the customer environment, and integration across teams. You will work closely with the Program Manager to connect the technical picture to the schedule, risks, and status reporting, while building and leading a small engineering team that grows with the program.

The program will deliver incrementally, beginning with a pilot and expanding into production on the same foundation. Because access, accounts, and authorization will move on the government’s timeline, this role requires someone who identifies those dependencies early and drives them to closure. An active Secret clearance is required on day one .

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the Technical Point of Contact
- Serve as DEFCON AI’s technical point of contact for the customer and industry partner
- Work closely with the Program Manager on scope, schedule, risk, and status reporting
- Own the technical increment plan from pilot through production and confirm the scope and acceptance criteria for each increment with the customer before work begins
- Track and drive government-side technical prerequisites, including accounts, access, approvals, and authorization

Own Cloud Platform Architecture and Delivery
- Own the architecture for deploying containerized services into a secure government cloud environment
- Lead cloud networking, identity, and hardened deployment, while ensuring the pilot is built on a baseline that can carry into production
- Work with partner engineering teams on hosting and integration and evaluate hosting options with clear recommended courses of action

Lead Data Integration and Decision Support
- Lead the integration of customer data sources into the delivered capability
- Shape decision-support views with the customer’s operations staff, including mapping, prediction, and alerting
- Partner with the Program Manager to define success measures with the customer before implementation and report results that inform decisions about the next

Global Partner Engineering is the technical engine behind Rubrik's partner business. We work with global systems integrators, channel partners, managed service providers and technology alliances to help them build, sell and support Rubrik at scale.

Our GSI team works with the largest integrators in the world. We co-create joint solutions with their practices, enable their practitioners through certification, and partner with our field teams to win large, complex deals. Partners are a core part of how Rubrik grows, and this team makes that real.

What this role will do :

You will lead Rubrik's global GSI technical organization, with two integrated charters that work as one system.
- Global Solutions - Architects build the play for named global GSIs: joint offers, reference architectures, blueprints and certification strategy with partner COEs. They work with Product on what is coming next and feed roadmap gaps back.
- Global Go-to-market - Architects run the play in the region. They pair with partner sellers and Rubrik account teams to build joint pipelines, shape deals, lead demos and POCs through close, and activate Black Belts.

- Shape the joint solution portfolio. Decide which GSIs get which offers, and run a repeatable pipeline that takes each offer from idea to adoption across our four product lines: enterprise and cloud data, identity, SaaS and AI agents.
- Build the operating system for the business. Run on cadence, clear ownership and one source of truth, so leaders spend their time on strategy and outcomes, not status.
- Drive deal excellence across every GSI motion, whether GSI-led, co-led or field-led. Bring the visibility and discipline to prioritize the right opportunities and win the technical decision.
- Be the senior technical voice with GSI executives and COE leaders. Partner with Rubrik Product, Marketing, Sales and Alliances to turn what GSIs need to sell into what we build next.
- Scale the partner field. Enable and certify GSI practitioners so partners can position and deliver Rubrik on their own.
- Attract, develop and retain high-agency leaders across the Americas, EMEA and APJ, and build a deep bench.
- Lead the team's AI transformation, with a clear productivity baseline, targets and new ways of working.

- Growth at scale. Rubrik has passed $1.6B in subscription ARR and is growing over 30% year over year.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Data Science, ML, and Data Platform team brings together data science, production ML, data engineering, and data platform to turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable products. These products help customers run safer, more efficient physical operations. As Head of Data Science, ML, and Data Platform, you will lead about 30 people through experienced managers and senior technical leaders, and report to the SVP of Engineering. You will decide where agents, foundation models, classical ML, and statistical methods belong at Samsara, and you will turn what you learn into how the whole organization works.

In this role, you will:
- Define an AI-native strategy and rethink the roadmap from first principles as capabilities change. Choose what to build, buy, stop, and scale.
- Partner with Product and Engineering to take intelligence from experiment to deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement in customer experiences.
- Build a trusted data foundation by making certified metrics, discoverable metadata, and traceable outputs available to people and agents across the organization, within clear permissions.
- Own production and economic outcomes, including reliability, latency, inference and infrastructure cost, and human oversight. Make evaluation a core capability, with failure modes, uncertainty, and regressions visible during development.
- Build a leadership team of managers and senior individual contributors and develop them. Hire people who combine scientific rigor, engineering ability, and a drive to keep learning.
- Lead the use of AI across the team. Raise the pace and technical ambition of every team through everyday use of AI-assisted development, and move recurring data science work, from data discovery to evaluation and monitoring, into reusable tools, agents, and workflows. Decide when greater autonomy is justified and when a simpler, more constrained system serves users better.
- Champi

To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6-month period.

Advancing the World’s Technology Together

Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you’ll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and powering the future.

We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We’re dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.

What You’ll Do

AI is changing data center infrastructure faster than any cycle before it, and memory is at the center of that change. As Director of Data Center Market Intelligence, reporting to the Sr. Director of Market Intelligence, you will lead the team that turns data center market dynamics into clear, reliable memory demand signals for DRAM, HBM and NAND/eSSD. You will be leadership's go-to source for weekly market sensing, build trusted relationships across the data center ecosystem, and work across Product Marketing, Sales, Product Planning and global headquarters teams. Company overview:

TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.

Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.

Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.

Director, Integrated Campaigns & Demand Generation

Location: Wilmington, MA, United States (Full-time on-site)

Position Summary

TraceLink is seeking an exceptional Director, Integrated Campaigns & Demand Generation to lead the strategy, execution, and performance of our global demand generation programs. This leader will play a critical role in scaling TraceLink's commercial growth by translating our technology innovations, thought leadership, and product offerings into integrated campaigns that generate qualified sales meetings, create pipeline, and accelerate revenue opportunities.

The Director will lead a team of campaign marketers and partner closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Sales Enablement, Sales, Marketing Operations, Sales Ops, GTM Engineering, GTM Intelligence, and our Brand, Content, and Digital teams to deliver compelling, coordinated go-to-market programs. A key priority will be building a scalable demand generation engine that supports TraceLink's Agentic Business Process commercialization strategy, from category awareness through solution-specific engagement and qualified commercial opportunities.

We are looking for a leader, a builder, a doer.. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who can develop sophisticated campaign strategies, lead a high-performing team, and personally drive initiatives through execution. The right candidate combines strategic thinking with operational discipline, strong marketing technology expertise, creative judgment, and a commitment to measurable business results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Integrated Campaign Strategy & Demand Generation
- Own the global integrated campaign strategy, translating corporate, product, and commercial priorities into executable demand generation programs.
- Design and deliver full-funnel, multi-channel campaigns that build awareness, engage target accounts, generate qualified sales meetings, and contribute to pipeline growth.
- Develop account-based, persona-driven, industry-specific, functional, and solution-oriented campaigns targeting

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The team’s squads focus on data and reporting, reconciliation, bank core systems, operating infrastructure, Upstart platform integrations, and consumer products.

This role requires strong cross-functional leadership, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of privacy frameworks, regulatory requirements, and data governance principles. You will work closely with teams across Legal, Compliance, Product, Data Platform, AI/ML, and Information Security to identify, assess, and mitigate privacy and data governance risks across Upstart's products and services.

About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

The Numenor team is building Valar’s next reactor, the flagship program that will define how we deliver nuclear power at scale. This dedicated team owns the entire plant, from the reactor core and helium systems to cooling, plant modules, and the Citadel, uniting mechanical, systems, safety, IC&E, quality, and supply chain under one mission. The work starts with bringing the first unit to life and ends with a production line that delivers reactors faster with every build. What this team builds will power the critical infrastructure of the future.

The Role

Valar Atomics seeks a Director, Systems Engineering for the reactor program. This role will build and lead the systems engineering organization for the reactor program. The scope covers the systems engineering process, the product breakdown structure (PBS), and the structure and technical accuracy of the reactor design basis. The role will lead systems integration and engineering from the first unit through scaled production, delivering reactors at an increasing rate.

The role demands someone who can develop, implement, and maintain a systems engineering architecture and high-value tools that enable Valar to produce and license Numenor series reactors at scale. Success in this role means producing and maintaining a tight design basis that scales, while always keeping a clear design thread for the required traceability.

Technical Leadership
- Own the systems engineering process for the reactor program.
- Own the plant architecture and the PBS, so every system fits one integrated design.
- Lead the reactor program’s design basis document set, including requirements baselines, system design descriptions, and functional analysis, and be responsible for its technical accuracy.
- Own safety classification and codes and standards with the safety basis team.

Integration, Verification and Readiness
- Run interface management across every system and close discrepancies in the model before they reach the floor.
- Own the V&V strategy, from requirement to evidence, through factory test, integrated test, and commissioning, working closely with the test director and test team.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Hardware Engineering is an innovative and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. We design, build, and perfect the products which are the eyes and ears of Waymo's autonomous driving technology, and integrate those products into vehicle platforms. We're seeking curious and talented teammates to keep us moving in the right direction.

Hardware Engineering designs, builds, and integrates the custom self-driving hardware (SDS), sensors, and base-vehicle systems that power the Waymo Driver. As Director, Software Engineering in Hardware, you will lead Software Engineering in this organization—spanning Embedded Software (ESWE), Sensor Software (lidar, radar, camera), Motion Control, Pose/Positioning, and ESWE/HIL Simulation, and the broader Hardware SWE community. You will drive the development, integration & platformization of our hardware-software stack across multiple vehicle platforms (Jaguar I-Pace, Zeekr Ojai/W12, Hyundai Ioniq 5/Apollo, and future programs), multiple generations of SDS Hardware and Sensors, and for multiple product lines.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and reports to the Senior Director of Software Engineering.

- Lead, scale, and mentor the Software Engineering organization within Hardware—spanning Embedded Software (ESWE), Sensor Software (lidar, radar, camera), Motion Control, Pose/Positioning, and ESWE/HIL Simulation, and the broader Hardware SWE community.

- Partner across Hardware Systems, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Base Vehicle OEMs, and Onboard Software to establish clean interfaces and left-shift validation onto HIL/Car-on-Bench simulation.

Job Description BAE Systems is hiring a VP of Information Technology (IT) to serve as the Platforms and Services (P&S) Segment VP of IT & Digital Officer (SIDO). The SIDO is a member of the IT and Segment leadership teams, reporting directly to the Chief Information and Digital Officer (CIDO), with dotted line reporting relationship to the P&S Segment Office of the President.

The SIDO serves as a trusted advisor to the Segment President/deputy and CIDO, providing strategic recommendations and guidance on IT investments and digital transformation initiatives that drive business growth, operational efficiency, and competitive advantage. The role also serves as the strategic interface between Segment and Enterprise IT leadership teams, ensuring effective partnerships across the functions and program leadership as well as efficient, outcome-driven delivery of IT, cybersecurity, and compliance services and products.

The SIDO represents the segment business needs and priorities in the IT strategic planning process and is responsible in advancing and implementing the enterprise-wide IT strategy locally within the segment. The SIDO proactively manages demand prioritization and drives value realization across major programs, shared services, and strategic initiatives.
• This position will be based in McLean, VA or Falls Church, VA ideally.
• There may be consideration to be based out of P&S sites including, York, PA; Jacksonville, FL; Louisville, KY; Sterling Heights, MI; or Maple Grove, MN.
• This role will be a hybrid position where you will work onsite at least three days a week, on average, based on business needs.
• There may be up to 25% of travel, including domestic and international.

The SIDO is expected to deliver the following key outcomes:
Develop and Execute IT Strategy

jsearch:convene:N1VTT2hNQTd4UUx0SGxkRUFB.description:
Role overview

Lead the design and hands-on rebuild of cloud, delivery, and AI infrastructure supporting customer-facing products and venue operations. The role combines strategic platform decisions with implementation, setting standards that product and corporate engineering teams can use to ship reliably and operate services with clear ownership.
Responsibilities
• Replace manual releases with an automated CI/CD path covering builds, deployment, and rollback.
• Define and migrate source control, CI, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code practices; document key trade-offs.
• Establish access controls, audit trails, secrets handling, environment separation, and practical recovery procedures.
• Build and operate an AI gateway for provider routing, credentials, rate limits, usage metering, and logging.
• Enable AI-assisted, specification-led development with episodic environments, rapid feedback, and automated checks.
• Track cloud and AI costs, improve observability and incident ownership, and support applications used by venue networking teams.
Requirements
• At least nine years building and operating production cloud infrastructure.
• Deep AWS experience, including multi-account environments, networking, IAM, and EKS and/or ECS.
• Experience handling production incidents, upgrades, and growth.
• Ability to communicate technical decisions and trade-offs to engineering, business, and executive audiences.
• A collaborative approach to code review, pairing, mentoring, and sharing operational knowledge.
• Practical use of AI agents for multi-step work, with the ability to verify their output against real systems.
Benefits and work setup

The position is described as hands-on, highly autonomous, and without direct reports listed base salary range is $180,000–$220,000, with a stated total rewards range of $198,000–$242,000 including an annual performance bonus. Benefits include health coverage, paid time off, parental leave, retirement matching, and education support.
