About Us

We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem.

We are a pioneering technology company, and our vision is of a future where a trusted and collaborative research ecosystem drives progress for all. We believe in better, open, collaborative and inclusive research. In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us?

Your new role

DS has grown through acquisition, and its products, data and engineering practices have grown up separately. This role leads the move from that fragmented portfolio to one platform: a single data platform and shared services that every DS product builds on, run by engineering teams working to a consistent operating model.

The VP owns engineering best practice across the group, defines and rolls out a single Target Operating Model (TOM) for engineering, and leads the transformation of today's operating model onto it. The role also owns the foundational layers of the platform (data platform, identity and access, logging, licensing and other shared services) and is accountable for their adoption by product and engineering teams.

The core challenge is to make the whole greater than the sum of its parts. Products should share data, services and standards, while current customer commitments and revenue-critical data releases stay dependable through the transition. Success means a trusted, reusable and commercially valuable data foundation, less duplicated capability, and faster, more consistent delivery across DS.

The VP also works with the Chief AI Officer to deliver the AI plan, and manages the transition of DS engineering to an AI-first software development lifecycle (SDLC).

What you’ll be doing

Engineering strategy and operating model

• Define and own engineering best practice across the group, covering architecture, data architecture, quality, infrastructure and FinOps.
• Design a single, consistent Target Operating Model for all engineering, and lead the transformation of the current operating model onto it.
• Agree an incremental platform roadmap with product leadership, with visible dependencies, early wins and clear progress measures.
• Lead adoption as well as build: agree integration paths with product teams, reduce duplicated capability and retire legacy components.
• Lead the rollout of an AI-first operating model across engineering, setting standards for AI-enabled development practices.

Unified data platform

• Deliver one data platform that underpins all DS applications and brings together data sources from across the group.
• Consolidate duplicated ingestion implementations onto a shared ingestion capability with common standards.
• Establish enrichment as a reusable platform capability, with clear ownership and a route to modernise long-standing algorithms and processes.

Lumira Search is partnered with a medtech start-up developing next-generation cardiovascular devices. Our client has a commercial product line in endovascular, and clinical stage transcatheter heart valve program.

This is a pivotal moment for the company, having recently vertically integrated manufacturing and closing a large finance round, they are consolidating into a new purpose-built facility in the Philadelphia area and restructuring into focused product divisions, each with dedicated leadership and the backing of an in-house manufacturing and development organisation.
The Role:

We’re looking to recruit technical leader to head R&D for the company's heart valve division. Think of this as leading a standalone valve start-up: you’ll act as the technical founder and CTO of the division, owning the development program end to end while building and leading a team of 5–10 engineers and scientists.

You’ll work alongside internal manufacturing, quality and regulatory functions, giving you the speed of a start-up with the infrastructure that most early-stage companies don’t have.
Responsibilities:
• Lead the technical strategy and execution of the clinical-stage surgical and transcatheter valve program
• Build, mentor and lead a high-performing R&D team of 5–10 people
• Drive design, verification and validation activities through clinical and regulatory milestones
• Partner closely with quality, regulatory, operations and manufacturing to move the program toward commercialisation
• Shape the culture, processes and long-term roadmap of a newly formed division
What We’re Looking For
• 10–15 years of medical device R&D experience, with strong experience in transcatheter heart valves
• Hands-on experience through one or more full product development cycles
• Proven people leadership and ready to step up
• Strong technical depth combined with the ability to set direction and make decisions in an early-stage environment
• Experience with polymer-based implants is a strong advantage
Why Join:
• A genuine founder-style leadership role with significant ownership and impact
• Competitive salary and benefits
• The chance to help bring a novel valve technology to patients

Location: This role is fully on-site at in the Philadelphia metro area.

Please note:

Whilst I'd like to respond to all candidates, due to the anticipated high volume of applicants I am simply unable to. If you do not meet the above requirements and haven't heard from me within 14 days of applying, please assume your application was unsuccessful.

Vizance is seeking a Director of Technology & Innovation to build, lead, and execute our technology strategy as we continue to grow. This is a new, hands-on position for someone who wants to learn the business, identify opportunities, and personally build the technology function Vizance needs for the future. This is an in-person position based in Vizance’s corporate office in Hartland, Wisconsin, where the individual will work closely with the executive team and leaders across the organization.

We are a growing independent insurance agency with approximately 320 associates across 25 locations in Wisconsin, Illinois, and Minnesota. Our growth strategy is built on three paths: organic growth, recruiting talented professionals, and mergers and acquisitions. Technology will play an important role in helping us scale each path while continuing to serve clients well and operate efficiently.

The Director of Technology & Innovation will be a hands-on builder, problem solver, and business partner. Working closely with Vizance’s executive team and other business leaders, this person will learn how our business operates, assess our current technology, and identify opportunities to improve systems and processes. The right person will be excited to shape this new role, turn ideas into practical solutions, and build the technology capabilities Vizance needs for the future.

This role may be a strong fit for a technology leader, business analyst, business process analyst, systems leader, or operational technology professional who is ready to build, learn, and have a meaningful impact. Experience in insurance, including at a carrier, agency, or related business, is helpful but not required.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT VIZANCE
• Build the Technology Roadmap: Learn our business and the insurance industry, assess our current technology, and develop a practical roadmap for where we need to go
• Put the Strategy into Action: Personally lead and contribute to key technology projects from discovery and requirements through implementation and adoption
• Advance AI and Automation: Identify and implement practical ways to use AI and automation to improve productivity, client service, and internal processes
• Use the Microsoft Ecosystem: Expand the practical use of Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Platform, Azure, and related tools to improve collaboration, automation, reporting, and business processes
• Improve Business Systems and Processes: Work directly with users to understand workflows, evaluate business software, document requirements, and determine what we should improve, replace, integrate, or add
• Support Our Growth: Build repeatable technology approaches for supporting new locations and teams and integrating systems and data through recruiting and M&A
• Coordinate Technology Resources: Work effectively with internal teams, vendors, consultants, and managed service providers while remaining personally engaged in the work

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO VIZANCE

About Charm
 
Our mission is to return the atmosphere to 280 ppm CO₂. We convert excess inedible biomass into carbon-rich bio-oil and inject it into underground storage for permanent carbon removal. At scale, we can use bio-oil to make fossil-free iron.
 
Our carbon removal efforts began in 2020 with initial purchases from customers like Stripe, Shopify, and Microsoft. Since then, we’ve scaled to thousands of tons of carbon removal, grown to over a hundred employees, and established three locations in San Francisco, Colorado, and Louisiana.
 
We're expanding our team of ambitious, creative, and hands-on problem solvers. We value psychological safety, collaboration, and continuous learning. We take calculated risks and treat mistakes as opportunities to improve. If you're excited about tackling big challenges, we encourage you to explore our company values.
 
Come help us reverse climate change. Gigatons or bust!


Charm is transitioning from building individual biomass, pyrolysis, and injection systems to building a first-of-kind scaled fleet across diverse geographies. That shift means our hardware has to be designed, documented, and released with technical excellence and consistency, producing design definition that fabrication, supply chain, and operations can trust. These systems also must achieve core process engineering fundamentals and performance standards for high reliability and uptime in production environments without excessive engineering oversight.
As the Senior Director of Engineering, you bring this scaled fleet to life by leading the organization responsible for architectural process engineering, hardware design and release, and BOM management across Charm's pyrolysis equipment and beyond. This team will take systems from first principle concepts to released, manufacturable design packages. You will set the expectations and cadence for design releases, implement reviews that are rigorous, empower effective decision making at all levels of the team, and deliver engineering improvements that ship on schedule. At a high level, your job will be to maximize signal-to-noise ratio to keep your teams focused on solving the right problems to advance the program’s goals.
Inherent to any novel technology, many of the problems you and your team tackle will arrive as design prompts without a complete set of specifications. Your leadership and technical capabilities will drive your team to turn this uncertainty into a set of requirements, risk-based trade studies, and a robust path forward. Often unanswered specs are informed by empirical testing; you will use rapid design revisions and your technical intuition on when to employ test rigs or sub-scale validation to avoid design paralysis at the system level. This requires a keen sense of when perfection is the enemy of good, and how to guide teams to make things exist first, and iteratively optimize them over time.

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Riviera Dining Group is redefining hospitality through elevated dining, vibrant nightlife, and immersive design. Vice President, Third Party Application Engineering – Eagle Performance

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Third Party Application Engineering – Eagle Performance to join our Performance & Compliance Engineering  team. This role is located in Boston, MA or Pittsburgh, PA .

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience with Eagle PACE Performance, investment data workflows, and performance reporting. In this role, you will partner across business and technology teams to define requirements, analyze workflows and data dependencies, and deliver scalable solutions for data ingestion, performance calculation, reporting, and operational processing.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
- Partner with business and technology teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into functional requirements, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria
- Analyze and document performance workflows, reporting processes, data lineage, business rules, and control points
- Work with financial data domains supporting performance processing and reporting, including holdings, transactions, pricing, FX, benchmark, reference, cash activity, corporate actions, and account data
- Configure, maintain, and document Eagle PACE Performance calculation setup, parameters, system settings, and related controls
- Support performance measurement workflows, including calculation, validation, reconciliation, and reporting
- Partner with engineering and data teams on data integration, warehouse mapping, and downstream reporting solutions
- Validate calculation outputs, reconciliations, data quality checks, and reporting results
- Ensure consistent business definitions across Eagle, reporting platforms, and downstream consumers
- Lead testing, implementation, and change management for new and enhanced workflows and reporting capabilities

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
- Typically 6-10 years of experience.
- Strong experience with Eagle PACE Performance or related Eagle platforms, including data flows, business processes, performance workflows, and reporting.
- Experience in performance measurement, performance reporting, or investment operations.
- Understanding of performance calculation concepts, data inputs, configuration dependencies, and controls.
- Strong understanding of financial data used in performance and reporting.
- Experience documenting workflows, system interactions, data mappings, and functional requirements.
- Strong SQL skills for validating data, reporting logic, and calculation outputs; Python is a plus.
- Experience with data integration, APIs, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, and downstream reporting solutions.
- Experience with reconciliations, exception handling, and workflow/data quality controls in financial data environments.
- Experience working in Agile env

oracle:bny:83173.description:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer  to join our Structured Debt team . This role is in New York City, NY or Pittsburgh, PA
You’ll build mission-critical applications that power high availability, high transaction throughput workflows, and meet stringent security controls—delivering modern experiences to our clients. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong emphasis on system design, AI-first development practices, and deploying resilient services in Azure AKS.
In this role, you'll have the opportunity to impact on our organization in the following ways:
- Design, build, and operate full stack solutions using Java, Spring Boot microservices, and Angular—optimized for scale, resiliency, and low latency.
- Apply AI-first coding practices to accelerate development: leverage AI-assisted code generation, test creation, refactoring, and documentation while maintaining software quality and security.
- Engineer cloud-native services for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including configuration, deployments, scaling, and observability.
- Implement robust system designs for high availability and high throughput: circuit breakers, back-pressure, idempotency, retries, and graceful degradation.
- Ensure security-by-design aligned to NIST 800-53 controls, including secure coding practices, secrets management, and compliance guardrails.
- Build streaming and event-driven integrations and RESTful APIs; instrument services for performance (APM, logs, metrics) and reliability (SLOs, error budgets).

You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. We use our proprietary data to understand the forces shaping the economy and develop policy solutions that promote economic growth.

- Well-known and respected in Washington, DC for relevant policy expertise.
- Executive presence with the ability to influence and engage senior external and internal stakeholders.

As an Assessment & Exercises Vice President at JPMorgan Chase within Cybersecurity Technology and Controls, you will be involved in evaluating controls and applications in a dynamic environment. Job Summary

Marriott operates and franchises hotels and licenses vacation ownership resorts and branded residential properties worldwide. Marriott’s Law Department services the Company’s lodging and hospitality business and provides legal advice and counsel to Marriott’s internal clients.

The Director, Data Security and Privacy Regulatory Compliance will be a member of Marriott International’s Law Department in the Global Legal Compliance group at Marriott’s corporate headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland. The Director will support the implementation, tracking, and day-to-day management of Marriott’s global data security and privacy regulatory compliance programs and initiatives. Working closely with attorneys, business stakeholders, and compliance professionals across the enterprise, the Director will assist in driving compliance with global legal and regulatory obligations related to cybersecurity, privacy, and data protection.

This position will report directly to the Senior Director, Global Compliance, and will support the execution of strategic regulatory compliance priorities, governance activities, assessments, reporting, training, and ongoing monitoring obligations.

Specific Job Duties, Responsibilities, and Expected Contributions

The Director’s primary responsibilities will be to:
- Support global compliance projects and manage day-to-day project management activities relating to data security and privacy regulatory compliance matters, including governance activities, training initiatives, communications, budgeting support, and compliance reporting.
- Serve as a key liaison with stakeholders across Global Information Security, Global Privacy Office, Global Technology, Loyalty, Customer Engagement Centers, Human Resources, Finance, Procurement, Communications, Operations, and other business teams to support compliance initiatives and information gathering efforts.
- Support third-party assessments and audits, including coordination activities, remediation tracking, evidence collection, and reporting.
- Assist in preparing executive presentations, compliance updates, dashboards, briefing materials, and other reporting artifacts for senior leadership, the Board of Directors, and governance committees.
- Develop and maintain tracking mechanisms, project plans, and reporting tools to monitor progress against regulatory compliance obligations, milestones, and remediation activities.
- Coordinate compliance activities across multiple departments and business functions to ensure commitments, deliverables, and reporting requirements are completed in a timely manner.
- Assist in the preparation and delivery of communications, awareness initiatives, and training programs related to cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory compliance matters.
- Support processes designed to ensure the Company fulfills ongoing regulatory obligations, including certifications, assessments, reports, documentation, and required submissions to regulatory authorities.

JOB SUMMARY

Assists department head in managing budget, capital expenditures, preventative maintenance and energy conservation. Accountable for maintaining the building and grounds with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection. Assigns, tracks and follows up on status of work assigned to staff and contractors. Helps increase guest and employee satisfaction through effective communications and training.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the engineering and maintenance or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 2 years experience in the engineering and maintenance or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Supporting management of Department Operations and Engineering Budgets

• Assists in effectively planning, scheduling and evaluating preventative maintenance programs.

• Helps establish priorities for total property maintenance needs.

• Supervises the day to day operations of Engineering.

• Assists in managing the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment, electrical and life safety systems.

• Maintains and operates equipment at optimum effectiveness, efficiency and safety.

• Supervises distribution of repair work orders.

• Assists in maintaining grounds, meeting rooms, ballrooms, public space, restaurants, property vehicles and recreational facilities as needed.

• Acts as technical liaison for all departments in property.

• Supervises Engineering in the absence of the Director of Engineering.

• Recommends or arranges for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and the replacement of furnishings and equipment.

• Selects and makes purchases of new equipment, supplies, and furnishings.

• Inspects and evaluates the physical condition of facilities in order to determine the type of work required.

• Manages parts, supplies and equipment inventories effectively by minimizing downtime and maximizing cash flow.

• Performs inspections effectively.

• Assists in evaluating and implementing new technologies, equipment and supplies.

• Assists in establishing and implementing an energy conservation program.

Maintaining Engineering Standards

• Helps ensure necessary permits and licenses for building and physical plant are obtained and kept current.

• Helps ensure regulatory compliance to facility regulations and safety standards.

• Ensures compliance with all Engineering departmental policies, standards and procedures.

• Ensures all employees have the proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Displays leadership in guest hospitality by exemplifying excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

JOB SUMMARY

Manages security/loss prevention operations on a daily basis. Areas of responsibilities include protection of property assets, employees, guests and property, accident and fire prevention and response. Ensures that all areas of the property are safe and secure. Maintains logs, certifications and documents required by law and Standard Operating Procedures. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maximizing the financial performance of the department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Criminal Justice or related major; 2 years experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Security/Loss Prevention Operations

• Assists in the development and implementation of emergency procedures.

• Conducts investigation of all losses of property assets and refers to proper management for disposition.

• Deploys security staff to effectively monitor and protect property assets.

• Comply with all Corporate Loss Prevention safety and security management guidelines and procedures.

• Conduct periodic patrols of entire property and parking areas.

• Recognize success across areas of responsibility.

• Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.

• Identifies and makes recommendations for minimizing physical hazards and unsafe work practices.

• Implements action plans to monitor and control risk.

• Maintains required reports and documentation regarding patrols of property and parking areas.

• Provides means for obtaining necessary medical attention on a timely basis.

Leading Security/Loss Prevention Teams

• Attends pre- and post-convention and weekly forecast meetings to understand group needs and gather critical information to communicate to Loss Prevention officers.

• Celebrates successes by publicly recognizing the contributions of team members.

• Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.

• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

• Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

oracle:marriott international:26150678.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Provides a high level of property maintenance knowledge. Position has overall responsibility for maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection. Accountable for managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintenance and energy conservation. Develops and implements strategies that will deliver products and services, which meet or exceed the needs and expectations of guests and employees while maximizing the financial performance. Responsible for maintaining standards and regulatory requirements. Leads the emergency response team for all facility issues.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the engineering and maintenance or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/Electrical/Plumbing.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 4 years experience in the engineering and maintenance or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/Electrical/Plumbing.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Engineering Operations and Budgets

• Works with property and regional engineering leadership team to determine how Engineering is performing against budget and highlights areas of concern to leadership.

• Manages the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment and electrical systems in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures.

• Administers service contracts to support property needs.

• Ensures fire crew has complete understanding of all procedures, equipment and alarms.

• Coaches and supports engineering leadership team to effectively manage controllable expenses (e.g., wages, heat, light and power, water consumption, tools and equipment, grounds keeping supplies, uniforms, vendors, service agreements, inventory, etc.).

• Manages and controls heat, light and power.

• Develops an engineering operating strategy that is aligned with the property/brand’s business strategy.

• Develops and manages Engineering budget.

• Ensures integration of departmental goals in game plans.

• Oversees execution of long term preventative maintenance and 10 year asset protection plans.

• Reviews financial reports and statements to determine how Engineering is performing against budget.

• Addresses potential areas of concern and proposing solutions to owners in a proactive manner.

• Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.

• Supervises construction to ensure timely completion of projects within budgetary guidelines.

Maintaining Engineering Standards

• Ensures compliance with state, local and federal regulations.

• Maintains property life safety systems (e.g., fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems, and alarm systems).

• Ensures building and equipment licenses, permits and certifications are current.

The Westin is committed to empowering guests to enhance their well-being when they need it most - while travelling. As The Westin associates, we rise to make each day better for our guests, our communities and each other. Discover a place where you’re given a choice to not just get up and go to work, but to rise. Join us as a Director of Engineering to feel empowered by career growth opportunities in a people-first environment.

Position Summary:

-
Rise with us by directing and managing the Day-to-day system operation and maintenance routines of the property

-
Create, develop and maintain strong relationships with key contractors and suppliers for equipment and relationship building

-
Oversee all preventive maintenance repairs, proactively identifying and fixing any repairs within the hotel.

-
Managing the engineering maintenance team and supporting them with operational tasks

-
Actively identify, conduct and manage repairs to the building and equipment

-
Oversee building & service standards and identify and implement improvement initiatives

-
Be an empowering leader by providing motivation and support to the team

-
Plan and execute team building activities for associates, creating a people-first environment and enhancing their overall wellbeing

-
Ensure you and the team uphold all company policies and procedures whilst demonstrating the hotel’s core values

About You:

-
Relevant managerial experience in general maintenance, property maintenance in hotels, facilities, residential or commercial.

-
Working rights in Australia

-
Enthusiastic to escalate your career

-
Self-motivated, driven and energized in a fast-paced environment

-
Armed with smart solutions and a can-do attitude

Our Benefits:

-
Exclusive staff discounts on food and beverage and hotel rooms (including all properties within the Marriott International group) for you, your family and friends

-
Be part of Life with the Works program where you can enjoy flexible working hours & locations, time off to pursue your passion through sabbatical leave, and paid leave during your birthday month

-
Grow, develop, and progress with internationally recognised training programs, unlimited strategic development and exciting career opportunities within the Marriott International group

-
Genuine care for associates’ physical, emotional and financial wellbeing through our Employee Assistance Program

-
Opportunity to receive Employee Referral Incentives and get paid for working with your friend

-
Work for the Largest Hotel Network in the World which values equality, diversity and inclusiveness

Westin Hotels and Resorts are part of Marriott International's Premium portfolio, which has committed to putting people first for 90+ years. Apply now!

oracle:oracle:350439.description:
Oracle Health is seeking a Senior Director Application Security to lead security across the design, development, delivery, and maintenance of its healthcare software and services. You will build a product security organization that helps protect health information, preserves the integrity of clinical workflows, and supports dependable care delivery.

You will set the strategy for secure architecture, application security, product assurance, and software supply chain protection across established products, cloud services, and AI-enabled capabilities. Working with engineering and product leaders, you will translate security requirements into reusable engineering controls and measurable product outcomes, aligned with Oracle Software Security Assurance (OSSA).

Key Responsibilities
- Strategy and organizational leadership. Own the product security roadmap, investment priorities, and operating model. Recruit and develop managers and technical leaders; allocate resources to the products and architectural weaknesses with the greatest customer impact.
- Secure architecture. Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for applications, APIs, interoperability services, and AI features. Establish patterns for identity, authorization, tenant separation, cryptography, auditability, and protection of sensitive clinical data.
- Secure development. Embed Oracle secure coding practices, automated security analysis, and risk-based release criteria into engineering workflows. Develop security champions and give teams practical guidance that prevents recurring defects.
- Independent product assurance. Direct product penetration testing, adversarial assessments, and investigation of complex design flaws. Turn findings into root-cause engineering changes and verify that fixes address the original weakness without disrupting clinical workflows.
- Software and AI supply chains. Improve assurance for dependencies, build systems, software artifacts, and AI integrations. Advance component traceability, artifact integrity, secrets protection, and validation of AI-generated code and agent permissions.
- Product vulnerability response. Coordinate product-impact analysis, fix design, and security maintenance with engineering and Oracle’s established disclosure processes. Partner with Exposure Management on affected-version mapping and deployment evidence; engineering and service owners execute remediation.
- Customer and regulatory assurance. Explain product security architecture and assessed risks to customer and internal leadership. Partner with Privacy, Compliance, Legal, and Federal teams on applicable requirements, evidence, and security commitments within approved policy.
- Results and accountability. Measure adoption of security practices, recurring defect reduction, assurance coverage, and fix effectiveness. Communicate material product risks, delivery dependencies, and investment choices clearly to executive leadership.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree

You will lead a program that connects discovered weaknesses to affected assets, accountable owners, clinical and business context, and validated remediation.

The role covers Oracle Health-operated services and infrastructure and coordinates with product and customer teams where deployment responsibility differs. You will build reliable visibility across cloud and on-premises environments, prioritize threats that matter most, and establish a consistent view of remaining risk. Success requires sound technical judgment and the ability to drive delivery across engineering, operations, and security organizations..

Key Responsibilities
- Exposure strategy and team leadership. Set the roadmap and operating model for posture assessment and exposure reduction. Lead managers and specialists, establish service expectations, and align staffing, tooling, and investment to material Oracle Health risks.
- Asset and deployment visibility. Reconcile discovery, scan, cloud, and software inventory data into an owned view of affected services and deployments. Identify blind spots, distinguish Oracle-managed from customer-managed scope, and track coverage confidence.
- Continuous posture assessment. Work with offensive security team to validate vulnerability scanning and configuration assessment for supported infrastructure, workloads, identities, and exposed services. Set coverage and data-quality standards and validate findings before they drive engineering work or executive reporting.
- Risk prioritization. Combine exploit evidence, attack paths, reachability, asset importance, and compensating controls to rank exposures. Explain potential effects on health-data confidentiality, clinical workflow integrity, service availability, and authorization obligations.
- Remediation delivery. Establish accountable engineering and operations owners, agreed deadlines, escalation paths, and evidence requirements. Drive common fixes for repeated weaknesses; coordinate testing and deployment windows that protect service and clinical continuity.
- Exceptions and residual risk. Ensure unresolved exposures have documented mitigations, expiration dates, review checkpoints, and approval by designated risk owners. Validate control effectiveness and escalate overdue decisions; risk acceptance follows Oracle’s established authority.
- Critical vulnerability and Federal coordination. Coordinate urgent exposure assessments with incident response, threat intelligence, Product Security, and service owners. Support Federal teams with finding-to-asset mapping, remediation evidence, and Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) traceability where applicable.

sitemap:at&t:103492691056.description:
This is a full-time onsite role based in the location(s) posted and is performed from the designated work location five days per week. No relocation is offered.

AT&T will not hire any applicants for this position who require employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Join AT&T and reimagine the communications and technologies that connect the world. The Technology Services organization is responsible for advancing information technology performance and delivering solutions with a focus on maximizing ROI, increasing efficiency and enhancing the experience of end users. Guided by experienced leaders, Corporate Systems seamlessly integrate with advanced Technology and Operations to drive our enterprise forward. Our Systems Reliability and Software Delivery teams are unwavering in their commitment to excellence, ensuring every solution is robust and efficient. When you step into a career with AT&T, you won't just imagine the future, you'll create it.

What You'll Do

The Director sets and governs AT&T's target-state architecture across the Consumer, Business and Corporate IT domains. The role owns the enterprise taxonomy, the technology standards and the architecture decision rights that turn business strategy into rationalized, reliable and AI-enabled technology portfolios. The Director leads through others at scale, builds coalitions with peer Directors and AVPs, and makes strategic, market-informed trade-offs.

Target State and Strategy
- Define and maintain target-state and transition-state architectures, domain roadmaps and integrated product roadmaps that align with business strategy and value streams.
- Make the traceability chain work in practice: customer journey → business capability → business process → functional capability → IT application.
- Drive portfolio rationalization, using lifecycle disposition (invest, sustain, migrate, retire) and TCO as the financial lens.

Domain Architecture and Taxonomy
- Own the EA taxonomy, the application classification model and the business capability maps, and keep them as the authoritative system of record.
- Lead domain architects across Mass Markets, ABS and Corporate Systems domains. Organize the work around domain clusters and domain-specific platforms.
- Make sure taxonomy data in tools like ServiceNow APM, LeanIX and other EA repositories is accurate, governed and usable in decisions.

Technology Standards and Lifecycle
- Establish and enforce enterprise technology standards, reference architectures, patterns and certified enterprise services.
- Run technology lifecycle management: emerging, standard, contain, sunset and retire.
- Promote reuse of components, services and patterns to reduce complexity and cost.

Decision Rights and Governance
- Define and operate the architecture decision-rights model: who decides, who is consulted and how decisions get escalated, across the enterprise, domain and solution tiers.
- Chair or co-chair the Architecture Review Board and the standards councils. Ow

DUTIES: Lead and direct a large team of data science professionals to translate complex business challenges into actionable insights and innovative solutions. Oversee the end-to-end workflow of data-driven projects—including data extraction, cleansing, feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, model creation, tuning, visualization, and deployment—using advanced statistical analysis, machine learning, and generative AI technologies. Drive informed decision-making and foster a culture of innovation across the organization. Lead the acquisition and preparation of data from diverse sources, both structured and unstructured (e.g., data lakes, cloud storage, internal/external databases). Ensure data quality through robust cleaning and preprocessing methodologies. Design and analyze extremely large and complex datasets (hundreds of terabytes or more), with a strategic approach to data usage and architecture. Oversee the creation of relevant features and conduct exploratory data analysis. Guide team members in coding solutions following a robust ML workflow: data extraction, cleaning, feature engineering, model selection/creation, hyperparameter tuning, interpretation, retraining, deployment, and monitoring. Ensure proficiency with at least one major data science language (Python, R, Scala, etc.) and expertise with modern ML libraries (e.g., Spark, Scikit-learn, Pandas, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, TidyVerse, AutoML tools). Direct the development, evaluation, and optimization of machine learning models, including hyperparameter tuning and post-deployment monitoring using tools like MLflow. Lead the implementation of models into production environments and ensure ongoing explainability, reliability, and minimal model decay. Foster expertise in a range of algorithm categories: supervised/unsupervised learning, optimization, deep learning, computer vision, NLP, deep reinforcement learning, search algorithms, and knowledge graphs. Drive the creation of impactful visualizations and reports for stakeholders using advanced coding and visualization tools (e.g., ggplot, D3.js). Collaborate across cross-functional teams to align analytical efforts with business objectives and strategic goals. Oversee the development and implementation of generative AI models for content creation and data augmentation. Guide the application of GANs, VAEs, Transformers, and other generative models. Foster expertise in prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the use of leading tools for text (GPT-3/4) and image generation (DALL-E, Stable Diffusion). Design and execute data strategies aligned with organizational philosophy. Supervise multiple teams, including other supervisors and staff; responsible for talent management, hiring, performance evaluations, promotions, and disciplinary actions. Team Background
The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. - Advance the derivatives exposure processing software infrastructure by continuously adopting new technologies where appropriate to solve business problems while adhering to Citi’s architectural guidelines. Citi is a global market maker and industry leader across all major Fixed Income markets. The Fixed Income Trade Processing (FITP) platform is Citi’s mission-critical global trade capture and risk management engine, processing 200,000+ transactions daily across Derivatives, Cash, Rates, Credit, and Exotic products for 2,000+ Front Office, Sales, and Middle Office users across 80+ countries supporting multiple businesses – Rates, Global Spread products, Markets Treasury and Finance Desk.
The platform interfaces with 60+ electronic trading venues and 20+ global regulatory bodies, providing real-time trade capture, low-latency risk and compliance feeds, and automated settlement orchestration.

Role Summary
We are seeking an exceptional, hands-on Lead Platform Architect & Engineer to spearhead the technical vision, architecture, and engineering execution for our next-generation, low-latency Fixed Income trade processing platform.
In this role, you will lead the strategic transformation of our core trading systems, driving microservices modernization, AI-assisted engineering adoption, and continuous cyber/vulnerability automation. - Low-Latency & Real-Time Feeds: Architect end-to-end data pipelines for low latency trade consumption, position keeping, and real-time distribution to downstream Risk, Compliance, MIS, and Clearing/Settlement systems.

- DevOps & Release Velocity: Champion automated quality gates, BDD/TDD practices, and zero-touch release automation (Release on Demand).

- Front-Office Business Partnership: Face off directly with Traders, Desk Heads, Quants, Middle Office, and Compliance leads translating complex trading needs into resilient technical solutions.

As a Principal AI Transformation Engineer , you will lead the strategic transformation and modernization of Citi’s Credit Risk Monitoring platforms—converting traditional UIs, manual analytical workflows, and legacy operational business processes into intelligent, AI-driven autonomous systems.

This pivotal role sits at the intersection of enterprise risk architecture and cutting-edge Generative AI. You will design, build, and deploy production-grade Agentic workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, custom LLM tools, prompt architectures, and intelligent conversational/generative interfaces that empower risk officers to monitor limit breaches, detect early warning indicators (EWIs), and orchestrate counterparty risk actions in real time.

This role requires deep hands-on engineering involvement (≥50% coding/prototyping), combining robust enterprise software engineering standards with state-of-the-art GenAI, Agentic orchestration frameworks, and system-level API/data integrations.

Key Responsibilities:

1. AI Stack Uplift, Agentic Systems & MCP Engineering (Hands-on ≥50%)
- Agentic Workflows & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and build autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents capable of reasoning, decomposing complex credit risk tasks, querying risk databases, and executing end-to-end monitoring actions with human-in-the-loop governance.
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) & Tool Development: Design and implement robust MCP servers and secure API tool connectors that expose internal risk services, data stores, calculation engines, and third-party financial telemetry to LLMs and AI agent frameworks.
- Prompt Engineering & Context Optimization: Develop, benchmark, and maintain production-grade prompt pipelines, dynamic context retrieval mechanisms, system personas, few-shot strategies, and structured output schemas (e.g., JSON mode / Pydantic validation).
- Evaluation, Guardrails & Observability: Implement enterprise AI guardrails (evaluating hallucination, toxicity, faithfulness, and PII masking), latency/token cost optimizations, and comprehensive tracing/observability for all LLM calls and agent execution trees.

Drive AI-powered credit risk oversight for one of the world's leading wealth management franchises as a Vice President, AI-Driven Credit Risk & Portfolio Management. In this role, you will monitor and assess wholesale credit and counterparty risk across lending, deposit, overdraft and broker-dealer portfolios supporting Citi Wealth's affluent, high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients globally. You will partner with risk, business, product, finance and technology teams to deliver portfolio insights, strengthen risk governance and apply AI-enabled analytics that inform decisions at the most senior levels.

Responsibilities
- Lead strategic initiatives across the wholesale product organization to strengthen credit risk management practices.
- Oversee risk monitoring for broker-dealer products and recommend mitigation strategies to reduce exposure.
- Monitor lending, deposit and overdraft portfolios to identify emerging risks, concentrations and performance trends.
- Apply AI-enabled analytics tools to independently conduct portfolio reviews and generate actionable risk insights.
- Prepare risk presentations and governance materials for senior leadership and oversight forums.
- Partner with risk, business, product, finance and technology teams to implement control enhancements and AI-driven solutions.
- Support regulatory, audit and remediation deliverables to maintain strong governance standards.
- Mentor junior analysts on risk analysis techniques and best practices.

- You bring 8+ years of experience in risk management, banking, analytics, consulting or financial services.
- You apply credit risk, portfolio management and risk governance frameworks to real-world business decisions.
- You hold a bachelor's degree.
- You use advanced analytical and problem-solving skills to evaluate complex portfolio data.
- You work with AI and data analytics tools such as Copilot, Tableau or Power BI to generate insights.
- You communicate complex risk findings clearly to stakeholders across business, risk and technology teams.
- You manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications
- You hold an advanced degree in finance, risk management, business or a related field.

What We Offer

Join a global risk function shaping how Citi Wealth protects and grows portfolios for affluent, high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients around the world.
- Work in a hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.
- Collaborate with risk, business, product, finance and technology teams across global markets.
- Shape governance and decision-making through portfolio-level risk insights.
- Build deeper expertise in AI-driven risk analytics through ongoing learning opportunities.
- Access programs supporting financial wellbeing, health and work-life balance.

Apply today to help shape the future of AI-driven credit risk management at Citi Wealth.

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

Vice President of Product-Product Agentic Platform, AI & Product Office owns the office's hardest and most ambiguous product bets, helping the Chief AI & Product Officer (CAIPO) drive Optum Health's enterprise AI-enabled product strategy, Agenix solutions portfolio and product capability agenda. Serving as strategist, builder and owner of the outcome, this role defines the problem with the people who do the work, decides what gets built and why and takes each product from first prototype through deployment and measurement. This role focuses on building a secure, governed and reusable agentic platform that enables product teams to develop, evaluate, deploy and monitor AI agents at enterprise scale.

This individual is accountable for measurable enterprise value: whether what shipped changed care for patients and care teams, whether it did so appropriately and whether it earns the return required to scale. The VP of Product keeps the work focused on the smallest version that can prove or disprove a bet, and brings clinical, operational, technology and governance partners into one team rather than a chain of handoffs.

This is a job for a builder. The team is just starting, and you will help build it and shape how it innovates, at the highest level. The office is small today, and that is by design: its leverage is the enterprise AI investment it drives across Optum Health. You will write, prototype and analyze with AI tools every day, and you will be where care is delivered, not only in meetings about it.

The AI & Product Office is building a small, cross-functional product team: product management, engineering, product design, service design, deployment and clinical, working alongside care team members from each local market team. The team embeds with a local Optum Health market team to find problems with the people who do the work, then design, build, deploy and measure the products that fix them. What the team learns in the first market is written down as the method for the next one.

If you are located in MA, you will have the flexibility to work remotely* as you take on some tough challenges.

New to North Carolina. Known for pursuing breakthroughs in medicine.
Ready to join our team?
At AbbVie, we bring together talented people and innovative science to develop medicines that help patients. The Director, Program Management will be responsible for the overall program implementation and oversight for assigned manufacturing and capital programs within the Engineering organization. The individual will be required to lead a cross-functional team to ensure program deliverables are achieved with adherence to approved budgets. The individual must have the ability to work independently, and also as an effective and engaged team leader.
Responsibilities:
- Lead and direct multiple cross-functional teams for the implementation of complex programs, managing strategy, execution and budget.
- Establish program strategy and timelines, defining technical and regulatory requirements to support regulatory approvals.
- Evaluate contingency plans and risk management strategies.
- Ensure effective communication within team and to Senior Leader stakeholders.
- Lead team discussions to resolve issues and ensure team alignment throughout program execution.
- Define budget requirements and report monthly actuals, LBE, and Plan/LRP schedules per financial schedule.
- Communicate program requirements, priorities and decisions, regularly and effectively.
- Guide cross-functional team in resolving conflicts and indecision's. Escalate when necessary.

- Bachelor in Science or Engineering; MBA preferred.
- Strong knowledge of GMP Manufacturing, Supply Chain, CMC technical development and pharmaceutical regulations is required.
- Demonstrated strong planning and project management skills while managing large, complex programs in the pharmaceutical industry.
- PMP certification a plus.
- 10+ years of industry experience, 5 or more years program management experience.
- Strong strategic thinking and leadership skills.
- Strong communication, organization, analytical, presentation, and people skills.
- Demonstrated experience in a global and multi-cultural environment.
- Proven ability to resolve conflict across cross-functional teams and technical experts.
- Ability to understand technical aspects of complex systems and guide cross-functional and detailed technical discussions during critical problem solving exercises

We welcome leaders from all backgrounds who bring varied perspectives and experience. You are a collaborative leader who values inclusivity, clear communication, and empathetic management. By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.
Why join the Harvard Radcliffe Institute?
The Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University, known colloquially as Harvard Radcliffe Institute, is one of the world’s leading centers for interdisciplinary exploration. We bring together students, scholars, artists, and practitioners to pursue curiosity-driven research, expand human understanding, and grapple with questions that demand insight from across disciplines.
The Fellowship Program annually supports the work of 50 leading artists and scholars. Academic Ventures fosters collaborative research projects and sponsors lectures and conferences that engage scholars with the public. The Schlesinger Library documents the lives of American women of the past and present for the future, furthering the Institute's commitment to women, gender, and society. The Emerging Leaders Program is a youth leadership development program partnering local high school sophomores with Harvard undergraduates in a mentoring relationship.
The Institute’s work is shaped by its history as the former Radcliffe College—a school founded to ensure that the standard of education embodied in Harvard was accessible to women, who were then excluded from the University. But the legacy of Radcliffe College is not simply coeducation at Harvard; it is the recognition that universities will always be greater when they draw wisdom and talent from the widest possible pool.
Take a look at this video to get different staff perspectives on working at Harvard Radcliffe Institute !

Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit. Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world. - The Academic Discernment and Exploration Office (ADEO): Newly established advising dedicated to helping students discern and navigate academic changes.

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World
Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

Director, Site Reliability Engineering
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally. Our XCaaS platform, the 8x8 Experience Communications Platform, brings voice, video, chat, contact center and communications APIs together in one cloud platform, so organizations can deliver better employee and customer experiences. Millions of people rely on it every day, and reliability is at the center of what we deliver.
Our engineering teams own their services in production. We are now building a central Site Reliability Engineering team with a platform-wide view. It will define how we measure reliability, build the tools and standards that help every team run their services well, and engineer shared points of failure out of the platform before they affect customers. We are looking for the Director who will build and lead it.
What will you do?
You will build 8x8's central SRE function from the ground up and lead a team across US and EU time zones. Your team will set service level objectives for our most important customer flows, improve observability and work with engineering teams to ensure the platform has the capacity and redundancy it needs. You will own the platform's dependency map and shared-infrastructure inventory, set the operational standards every service is held to, and prove through regular testing that failover works. Engineering teams keep ownership of their services. Your team covers the parts of the platform that no single team owns and raises the reliability bar for everyone.

- Build and lead a global SRE team across US and EU time zones, including its charter, operating model, hiring and career development.
- Define the reliability strategy and multi-year roadmap for the 8x8 platform, aligned with business and customer priorities.
- Establish SLIs, SLOs and error budgets for critical customer journeys, and use them to guide engineering priorities and balance release velocity with stability.
- Set platform-wide standards for observability, including monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting, with a focus on actionable, customer-impacting signals.

- Partner with platform and CI/CD teams to build reliability into the software delivery lifecycle, including progressive rollouts and automated rollback.
- Own capacity planning and performance engineering for shared infrastructure and high-traffic services.

WORKING AT ABBOTT:

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

Abbott's digital products help people around the world manage their health, from glucose monitoring and nutrition to diagnostics and medical devices. Behind them are the shared platforms that every Abbott digital team builds on. We are looking for a Director of Platform Engineering & Reliability to lead them.

This is a builder's role, with the mandate to modernize these platforms, replace manual requests with automated self-service, and grow a high-performing team across the Americas, Europe and Asia. It suits a leader with deep platform and cloud expertise, a track record of putting AI to work in engineering and operations, and operational rigor in regulated environments.

THE OPPORTUNITY
At Lingo, we’re building a groundbreaking health platform that combines continuous biosensor data, real-time analytics, and personalized insights to help people live fuller, longer, and healthier lives. Our systems ingest millions of sensor readings daily, powering experiences for consumers and partners worldwide, with the reliability and scalability of cloud-native, enterprise-grade platforms.

We are looking for a Director of Test Engineering to help accelerate growth across the U.S., Spain, and India. In this role, you will build and lead a world-class, globally distributed software test engineering function. The role requires a hands-on leader who thrives in building, can roll up their sleeves alongside their team, and understands that quality in a consumer health platform is both a technical discipline and a direct expression of how much we care about the people using our product.

You will own the end-to-end software testing strategy across Lingo’s platforms, mobile applications, CGM and biosensor data pipelines, AI/ML models, and the broader consumer platform. You will also grow and unify a global team of software quality engineers who operate with the same standards and urgency regardless of time zone.

What You’ll Work On
- Architect and scale a distributed software test engineering team across the U.S., Spain, and India, establishing the hiring strategy, team structure, and operating model that supports Lingo’s growth trajectory.
- Create a unified quality engineering culture across geographies, operating with the same standards, tools, and sense of ownership.
- Define career paths, mentorship frameworks, and performance expectations that attract and retain top quality engineering talent globally.
- Oversee test function staffing, resource planning, budgeting, tooling, test platforms, and third-party vendor relationships across all regions.
- Own the quality architecture and test strategy across Lingo’s full technology stack, iOS and Android consumer applications, CGM and biosensor data ingestion pipelines, AI/ML inference services, and backend platform services.
- Lead verification strategy for biosensor and CGM data integrity, ensuring that data flowing from wearable hardware through ingestion pipelines to consumer-facing insights is accurate, reliable, and auditable.
- Build and maintain the testing infrastructure required to support continuous, high-frequency releases across mobile and platform surfaces.
- Establish standards for CI/CD integration of automated test suites, ensuring quality signals are fast, reliable, and actionable for engineering teams.

Job Details:

Job Description:
About the role
Altera is looking for a Director to lead AI and Software Security (Head of AI & Product Security) . The Director is accountable for the company wide AI Security Lab and the Software Security program for product, application, and engineering software. Software Security is a core responsibility, not a service limited to product reviews or release gates. It covers architecture and design, development, build, release, operation, vulnerability response, and retirement.

The AI Security Lab serves Corporate, Software, Hardware, and the other security teams. The Director owns Software Security for Altera software that is built, acquired, integrated, or substantially customized. This includes products, applications, APIs, SDKs, developer tools, engineering systems, cloud services, AI software, source repositories, build systems, and delivery pipelines. The Software Security Architect / App/SW Security Tech Lead reports to this Director and leads secure architecture and threat modeling. The Director sets the program direction, standards, coverage, and assurance. Engineering and application owners implement and operate their systems and fix findings. The security team sets requirements, advises, checks results, and escalates unresolved risk.

The Director sets priorities and standards and works directly with engineering leaders to address software and AI risks. The role partners with Product, Software, Hardware, Corporate Technology, Legal, Privacy, and Information Security.

What You'll Do
Set the AI and Product Security strategy
·      Define and maintain Altera’s AI, product, application, and secure development security strategy, roadmap, operating model, and control objectives.
·      Translate business goals, product risks, customer expectations, and applicable obligations into pragmatic security requirements and measurable plans.
·      Establish clear ownership, decision rights, risk acceptance paths, escalation criteria, and interfaces with other security and engineering functions.
·      Advise the CISO and business leaders on material AI and product risks, investment priorities, exceptions, and residual risk.
·      Establish service priorities and intake for the AI Security Lab, balancing demand from Corporate, Software, Hardware, and the security verticals.

Lead the AI Security Lab
·      Run the AI Security Lab for Corporate, Software, Hardware, and the security teams. Set priorities for its reviews, testing, and guidance.
·      Set security requirements for AI systems, models, agents, copilots, and AI features with AI owners, Engineering, Privacy, and Legal.
·      Oversee adversarial testing of AI features and agents. Test for prompt injection, unsafe tool use, data exposure, misuse, and related weaknesses.
·      Oversee secure AI adoption practices, including data protection, access controls, model and vendor risk review, secure integration, monitoring, and lifecycle change management.

Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking IT leader to drive end-to-end enterprise solution architecture and enable the transformation of traditional business and IT operating models into intelligent, AI-enabled operating models.

This role will be responsible for defining integrated, scalable and sustainable enterprise solutions that connect business processes, enterprise applications, data, integrations and emerging AI capabilities.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of business process expertise, enterprise application knowledge, architectural leadership and an understanding of emerging technologies, including Agentic AI.

The individual will play a critical role in reimagining how enterprise business processes are designed, orchestrated and executed by leveraging enterprise platform capabilities, intelligent automation, AI agents and human-in-the-loop operating models.

This is a Director-level architecture leadership role that will operate in an individual contributor capacity, driving enterprise-wide outcomes through cross-functional leadership, influence and architectural governance.

- Own and drive end-to-end solution architecture across enterprise value streams, including Idea-to-Offer, Quote-to-Cash, Plan-to-Fulfill, Procure-to-Pay and Record-to-Report.
- Partner with business and IT leaders to translate business strategies and requirements into integrated, scalable technology solutions.
- Define current-state, future-state and transitional architectures aligned with enterprise technology strategy and business objectives.
- Develop enterprise application and solution architecture roadmaps supporting business growth, transformation and modernization initiatives.
- Lead strategic IT programs and cross-functional transformation initiatives, driving solution strategy, stakeholder alignment, execution and business outcomes.
- Lead IT assessments and technology due diligence for mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, evaluating application landscapes, business capabilities, integration complexity, technology risks and potential synergies.
- Define M&A integration strategies, target-state architectures and phased implementation roadmaps to enable business continuity and synergy realization.
- Assess cross-functional process dependencies, capability gaps and upstream and downstream impacts of architectural decisions.
- Drive business process simplification, standardization, application rationalization and platform consolidation.
- Lead technology evaluations, solution selection and architectural assessments, balancing business value, cost, complexity and scalability.
- Define and drive the solution architecture strategy for transitioning toward an Agentic AI-enabled operating model.
- Partner with business and IT teams to reimagine business processes leveraging AI agents, intelligent automation, AI-driven decision-making and human-agent collaboration.

AssetMark provides investment and practice management solutions that help independent financial advisors serve their clients.

Space Vehicle Chief Architect, Lead The Opportunity:
Are you looking for an opportunity to combine your technical skills with big picture thinking to make an impact on National Security? You understand your customer’s environment and how to develop the right systems for their mission. Your ability to translate real-world needs into technical specifications makes you an integral part of delivering a customer-focused engineering solution.

As a systems engineer on our team, you’ll have the chance to lead space vehicle systems engineering efforts. Your customer will t rus t you to not only design and develop these systems, but also evolve them with advanced technology solutions.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

- 10+ years of experience with space vehicle systems engineering, planning, and integration

- 7+ years of experience with reviews of space systems, including SRR, SDR, SFR, PDR, CDR, TRR, FCA, SVR, MRR, or PCA, and the DoD acquisition system
- 5+ years of experience with risk and opportunity management and articulating program risk posture
- Ability to be highly motivated, have a dynamic work ethic, and contribute to the DoD mission
- Ability to communicate and establish collaborative relationships with government clients and contractor teammates
- TS/SCI clearance
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or CS

- Experience with computer tools, including Confluence or Jira
- Experience designing, building, and testing communications antennas, transmitters, or receivers of a payload
- Experience with mission assurance in strategic or tactical MILCOM payload development
- Knowledge of DoD systems engineering, testing, and production policies and practices
- Ability to perform multiple systems engineering and program management functions in support of design reviews and requirements verification
- Possession of excellent interpersonal skills
- ​Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills

​ Clearance:
Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Technical Director The Opportunity:
At a certain point, experience-based system design can start to look like clairvoyance. When you’ve developed so many systems that you can not only orchestrate the best solution for any technology-based challenge, but you can also anticipate and preempt future issues, you’re a solutions architect. You’ve evolved your skills into strategy through a long path of software development accomplishments and the curiosity to understand how all the pieces of an IT ecosystem fit together. Are you ready to use your combination of knowledge, skill, and experience to take on the toughest challenges in the Department of War

As a Technical Director on our team, you'll translate your customer’s IT needs and future goals into a plan by crafting design specifications. Through your leadership, we’ll help transform the way the Department of War uses technology including cloud migration, integrating advanced technology, and modernizing legacy systems. And, what do you do next in a career where you’ve reached this level? You mentor the next set of developers to help them grow into tomorrow’s solutions architects. As a technical leader, you’ll shape the digital solutions business and identify opportunities for growth.

Work with us and build the future of technology in the defense industry for the better.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:
- 12+ years of experience with computer, network, software, and information systems engineering
- 8+ years of experience supporting a Defense client
- 6+ years of experience with technical leadership
- 3+ years of experience managing product delivery
- Experience working in a technical discipline
- Ability to solve complex engineering challenges in information technology
- Ability to communicate, plan, and present a well-organized approach to technical solutions and execution
- Ability to obtain a TS/SCI clearance
- Bachelor's degree

Nice If You Have:
- Experience working across multiple cloud providers or classification levels on the same program, including navigating the translation between platforms
- Experience on a large defense program or with a major systems integrator, including delivering under bureaucratic friction without losing technical momentum
- Experience supporting DoD installations or integrating with mission or C2 systems across NIPR, SIPR, or coalition networks, including where the technical environment was inherited and undocumented
- Experience building agentic workflows, automation pipelines, or custom tooling that meaningfully changed what your team could ship
- Experience in a technical lead or principal role where you were accountable for both the architecture and the delivery
- Experience operating on a tiger team or rapid response unit parachuting into a problem, delivering under compressed timelines, and moving on cleanly
- TS/SCI clearance
- AWS Certification

Your team

The Aladdin BlackRock Data Office (BDO) builds trusted, scalable, and governed data products that advance the firm’s enterprise data strategy. ClientIQ is a strategic initiative bringing together data, analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) to power next-generation client intelligence and engagement.
The team builds modern data and technology capabilities powering our global sales organization, partnering across engineering teams, data governance, and client teams to deliver intuitive data solutions, actionable insights, and AI-powered workflows.

As the Director of Mission Systems Engineering , you will lead the organization responsible for defining, developing, integrating, and sustaining the mission systems that enable safe, reliable, and efficient spacecraft operations. This role is part of the Ground & Spaceflight Operations team, supporting Blue Ring and related space mobility missions across national security, civil, and commercial customers.

This role requires an accomplished people leader with substantial technical depth and sound systems engineering judgment. You will partner with program leadership, vehicle engineering, ground software, mission analysis, flight operations, integration and test, customers, and external providers to translate mission objectives into executable architectures and operational capabilities.
The ideal candidate can build and develop teams, resolve complex technical challenges, and balance performance, safety, cost, schedule, and operability. You will bring a long-term perspective while delivering near-term commitments, establishing reusable capabilities that reduce mission lifecycle costs and improve operational effectiveness.

You own spacecraft software from architecture and requirements through verification and release, and you support the vehicle through integration, launch, commissioning, and on-orbit operations of the full fleet.

You will build and lead the Terwave Spacecraft software team from vehicle design into integration and operations. The Director serves as a strategic advisor to executive leadership and partners closely with enterprise sponsors to drive successful transformation and integration outcomes across the organization. At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Broadridge is hiring! We’re seeking a Vice President, AI Business Operations Transformation to lead the establishment of an AI-first program across ICS, driving operational efficiency, new revenue opportunities, and faster time to revenue for new business. This leader owns the end-to-end path from identifying AI opportunities through assessment and solution design to scaled delivery and adoption, ensuring each initiative is tied to measurable business outcomes, appropriate risk controls, and sustained operational change.

This is a hybrid role: that requires a strong understanding of technology, a delivery mindset, and the ability to influence change across the organization.
